title: Green Rewards Card: How the Sustainability Tracker Works
summary: Explains how the Green Rewards Card Sustainability Tracker categorizes card purchases by merchant category and spend type, maps eligible categories to emissions factors, and applies automatic CO₂ offsets. It states the offset rate ($0.06 pounds CO₂ per $1 spent), monthly reporting cadence, and how returns/refunds and merchant reclassifications affect what appears in the monthly dashboard.
faqs: How does the Sustainability Tracker categorize my card purchases (merchant category and spend type)?
How are estimated emissions calculated from eligible merchant categories (emissions factors mapping)?
How does the tracker calculate offsets—what is the $0.06 per $1 spent CO₂ offset rate?
What is the reporting schedule for sustainability/carbon reports, and what do they aggregate?
How are returns and refunds handled in the reporting period?
If a merchant reclassifies a transaction, when will it show up in my next monthly report?
What can I do to improve data accuracy for recurring vendors and receipt tagging?
keywords: Transaction categorization by merchant category and spend type
Automatic offset: $0.06 pounds CO₂ per $1 spent
Returns and refunds netted to reporting period
Merchant reclassifies category updates to next monthly report
Real-time spend segmentation by category and by cardholder
